title: Montez Sweat 2023 NFL Panini Green Prizm Washington Commanders #299
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a Montez Sweat 2023 Panini Prizm trading card featuring the Washington Commanders player in a Green Prizm parallel/variety. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original, not a licensed reprint. It is part of the 2023 Panini set and has the card number 299.

The card is in English and was manufactured in the United States. It is a sports trading card for football fans, specifically fans of the National Football League (NFL). The card features Montez Sweat, a player for the Washington Commanders, and is ideal for collectors of sports memorabilia.
